template_data.headline_html: Four moves that actually build your way in.

items.title: Start with your warm list
items.desc: Your commercial clients and vendors include federal primes. That's where to start — not cold outreach.

items.title: You're solving their mandate
items.desc: Federal primes are contractually required to sub to small businesses. Find them before the solicitation drops.

items.title: Get it in writing
items.desc: "We'll work together" is not a teaming agreement. A signed document is what shows up in your past performance record.

items.title: Log every dollar of sub work
items.desc: Agency, amount, deliverable. That file is what you bring to your own prime bid two or three years from now.
